title: Hold Susi Core to the 10-second line
goal: Vision: the CEO's words of 2026-11-22 (recorded as V-42 in Susi): 'moving forward, ecosystem must be blazing fast - no more waiting more than 10s for anything - test, releases whatever it is.' Susi Core's contract states the line: every operation an agent waits on finishes within 10 seconds warm, measured and reported with cold timings apart; over the line is a defect to fix, never a refusal, and never bought with weaker tests. It names how the whole suite runs fast (cargo-nextest, as scripts/check-hermetic-tests.sh already does) and where the measurements are kept. Core's Linux gates run the tests side by side. The ecosystem page says Susi Tools now holds its first tool.
progress: 2026-11-22: the goal is delivered on main (ab6e16b96, 926972650 and the correction after them): the contract states the line and where it stands, .config/nextest.toml no longer names removed test programs, the Linux gates run the tests under cargo-nextest, and the ecosystem page says Susi Tools holds its first tool. The acceptance passes on Linux (the Linux gates ran the whole suite at 926972650: 434 run, none failed). Not closed, for the same reason as T-CLAUDE-421: `susi-tools tasks close` runs the acceptance on the machine that closes, and Susi Core does not build on Windows (recorded in Susi's task T-CLAUDE-33).
